column1: # Researched 2026-11-01. Fields: dataset, event date (ISO8601 or recorded), source text.
# recorded = attribution documented for this import on the supplied download day;
# it is NOT an asserted acquisition/publication date. Year-only dates stay in text.
# Unknown times use 00:00 UTC according to the provenance convention.
# Original authors, repositories and related publications are distinguished below.
# tooth: no reliable original creator identified; script supplies download evidence only.

column3: Origin attribution (acquisition date unknown): Philips Research, Hamburg; distributed by VolVis.org. Corroborating original NRRD documentation: https://teem.sourceforge.net/nrrd/volvis/index.html

Origin attribution (acquisition date unknown): Kevin Kreeger, Viatronix; CT supplied through VolVis.org. Curator evidence: https://github.com/sci-visus/open-scivis-datasets/blob/main/static/open-scivis-datasets/backpack/backpack.json

Acquired by UZH Computer-Assisted Paleoanthropology and Visualization and MultiMedia Lab; microCT, 20 micrometers. Acquisition date unknown. Research-use acknowledgement requested; partial SNSF support 200021_132521. https://www.ifi.uzh.ch/en/vmml/research/datasets.html

Requested acknowledgement: "We acknowledge the Computer-Assisted Paleoanthropology group and the Visualization and MultiMedia Lab at University of Zurich (UZH) for the acquisition of the μCT datasets." https://www.ifi.uzh.ch/en/vmml/research/datasets.html

Origin attribution (simulation date unknown): NASA Ames / NASA Advanced Supercomputing Division. This regular-grid derivative was resampled from an unstructured tetrahedral grid, according to the Volume Library: https://www.volume.open-terrain.org/ ; historical source https://www.nas.nasa.gov/Research/Datasets/datasets.html

Origin attribution (acquisition date unknown): Stefan Roettger, VIS, University of Stuttgart; distributed by VolVis.org. Corroborating documentation: https://teem.sourceforge.net/nrrd/volvis/index.html

Origin attribution (scan date unknown): TeraRecon, Mitsubishi Electric Research Laboratories and Brigham and Women's Hospital; CT of the SIGGRAPH 1989 teapot, not a scan dated 1989. https://teem.sourceforge.net/nrrd/volvis/index.html

CT acquisition completed 2000-01-28: Terry S. Yoo, NLM; Geoff Rubin and Sandy Napel, Stanford Radiology; physical bunny supplied by Marc Levoy. Source README: https://graphics.stanford.edu/data/voldata/bunny-README ; this is CT data, not the laser-scanned bunny mesh.

Origin attribution (scan date unknown): Michael Scheuring, Computer Graphics Group, University of Erlangen. Curator evidence: https://github.com/sci-visus/open-scivis-datasets/blob/main/static/open-scivis-datasets/carp/carp.json

CT scanned by Matthew Colbert at UT Austin UTCT on 2003-07-11; Chamaeleo calyptratus TNHC 62768, supplied by Travis LaDuc, processing by Jessie Maisano. 1080 coronal slices. https://digimorph.org/specimens/Chamaeleo_calyptratus/whole/

Dataset released in 2002 by Armin Kanitsar, TU Wien; Siemens Somatom Plus 4 Volume Zoom CT at Vienna General Hospital. Exact scan date unknown. https://www.cg.tuwien.ac.at/research/publications/2002/dataset-christmastree/

Related publication (2002): Kanitsar et al., Christmas Tree Case Study: Computed Tomography as a Tool for Mastering Complex Real World Objects with Applications in Computer Graphics. https://doi.org/10.1109/VISUAL.2002.1183812 ; author record https://publications.graphics.tudelft.nl/papers/648

Origin attribution (simulation date unknown): University of Utah, Center for the Simulation of Accidental Fires and Explosions (CSAFE), burning heptane jet. Curator evidence: https://github.com/sci-visus/open-scivis-datasets/blob/main/static/open-scivis-datasets/csafe_heptane/csafe_heptane.json

Simulation attribution (run date unknown): Marco Atzori, Ricardo Vinuesa, Adrian Lozano-Duran and Philipp Schlatter; Swedish SNIC computing resources. Curator evidence: https://github.com/sci-visus/open-scivis-datasets/blob/main/static/open-scivis-datasets/duct/duct.json

Related publication (2021): Atzori et al., Intense Reynolds-stress events in turbulent ducts, International Journal of Heat and Fluid Flow 89, 108802. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.ijheatfluidflow.2021.108802 ; author manuscript https://re.public.polimi.it/retrieve/082c902d-9a7c-4487-9d00-36496d380fca/ATZOM02-21.pdf

Origin attribution (acquisition date unknown): General Electric; engine-block CT distributed by VolVis.org. Curator evidence: https://github.com/sci-visus/open-scivis-datasets/blob/main/static/open-scivis-datasets/engine/engine.json

Origin attribution (scan date unknown): Philips Research, Hamburg; rotational C-arm foot scan distributed by VolVis.org. Corroborating original documentation: https://teem.sourceforge.net/nrrd/volvis/index.html

Origin attribution (scan date unknown): Lawrence Berkeley Laboratory Whole Frog Project. The SciVis catalog identifies this volume as the MRI derivative; the project also has separate mechanically sectioned images. https://froggy.lbl.gov/ ; volume identification https://github.com/sci-visus/open-scivis-datasets/blob/main/static/open-scivis-datasets/frog/frog.json

Origin attribution (simulation date unknown): DFG SFB 382; fuel-injection simulation distributed by VolVis.org. Curator evidence: https://github.com/sci-visus/open-scivis-datasets/blob/main/static/open-scivis-datasets/fuel/fuel.json

Simulation attribution (run date unknown): Gaurav Bansal, Ajith Mascarenhas and Jacqueline H. Chen; first timestep of stratified DME/air autoignition. Curator evidence: https://github.com/sci-visus/open-scivis-datasets/blob/main/static/open-scivis-datasets/hcci_oh/hcci_oh.json

Related publication (2015): Bansal, Mascarenhas and Chen, Direct numerical simulations of autoignition in stratified dimethyl-ether (DME)/air turbulent mixtures, Combustion and Flame 162, 688-702. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.combustflame.2014.08.021

Origin attribution (simulation date unknown): DFG SFB 382; hydrogen-electron probability in a strong magnetic field, distributed by VolVis.org. https://github.com/sci-visus/open-scivis-datasets/blob/main/static/open-scivis-datasets/hydrogen_atom/hydrogen_atom.json

Simulation attribution (run date unknown): transverse-jet DNS, Q-criterion field; Grout, Gruber, Kolla, Bremer, Bennett, Gyulassy and Chen. Curator linkage: https://github.com/sci-visus/open-scivis-datasets/blob/main/static/open-scivis-datasets/jicf_q/jicf_q.json

Related publication (2012): Grout et al., A direct numerical simulation study of turbulence and flame structure in transverse jets analysed in jet-trajectory based coordinates, JFM 706, 351-383. https://doi.org/10.1017/jfm.2012.257 ; institutional record https://www.sandia.gov/research/publications/details/a-direct-numerical-simulation-study-of-turbulence-and-flame-structure-in-tr-2012-09-10/

CT scanned by Matthew Colbert, UT Austin UTCT, 2003-10-24, 795 slices. Lampropeltis getula egg supplied by Travis LaDuc; Tim Rowe / NSF Digital Libraries funding. https://www.digimorph.org/specimens/Lampropeltis_getula/egg/whole/

Archive attribution (scan date and original operator unknown): SUNY Stony Brook VolVis distribution; resin-embedded lobster CT. https://github.com/sci-visus/open-scivis-datasets/blob/main/static/open-scivis-datasets/lobster/lobster.json

Simulation attribution (run date unknown): William Daughton, Los Alamos National Laboratory; distributed with assistance from Berk Geveci, Kitware. https://github.com/sci-visus/open-scivis-datasets/blob/main/static/open-scivis-datasets/magnetic_reconnection/magnetic_reconnection.json

Associated preprint submitted (not simulation time): Guo, Li, Daughton and Liu, Formation of Hard Power-laws in the Energetic Particle Spectra Resulting from Relativistic Magnetic Reconnection. https://arxiv.org/abs/1405.4040 ; published as PRL 113, 155005 (2014), https://doi.org/10.1103/PhysRevLett.113.155005

Origin attribution (acquisition date unknown): Frederick Federer, Moran Eye Institute, University of Utah; GFP-labelled marmoset V1 pyramidal neurons, two-photon microscopy. No specific primary publication uniquely established for this volume. https://github.com/sci-visus/open-scivis-datasets/blob/main/static/open-scivis-datasets/marmoset_neurons/marmoset_neurons.json

Synthetic benchmark introduced by Stephen R. Marschner and Richard J. Lobb (1994); this sampled version is redistributed through VolVis/Open SciVis. Author publication page: https://graphics.stanford.edu/~srm/publications/Vis94-filters-abstract.html

Original benchmark publication (1994): Marschner and Lobb, An Evaluation of Reconstruction Filters for Volume Rendering, IEEE Visualization, 100-107. https://doi.org/10.1109/VISUAL.1994.346331 ; author manuscript https://www.graphics.cornell.edu/pubs/1994/ML94.pdf

Simulation attribution (run date unknown): Andrew W. Cook, William Cabot and Paul L. Miller, Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory; Rayleigh-Taylor density field. https://github.com/sci-visus/open-scivis-datasets/blob/main/static/open-scivis-datasets/miranda/miranda.json
Related publication (2004): Cook, Cabot and Miller, The mixing transition in Rayleigh-Taylor instability, JFM 511, 333-362. https://doi.org/10.1017/S0022112004009681

Origin attribution (scan date unknown): Dirk Bartz, VCM, University of Tuebingen; 1.5T CISS head MRI distributed by VolVis.org. https://github.com/sci-visus/open-scivis-datasets/blob/main/static/open-scivis-datasets/mri_ventricles/mri_ventricles.json

Origin attribution (scan date unknown): Siemens Medical Systems, Iselin, New Jersey. Do not confuse this MRI with the NLM Visible Woman collection. Curator evidence: https://github.com/sci-visus/open-scivis-datasets/blob/main/static/open-scivis-datasets/mri_woman/mri_woman.json

Origin attribution (scan date unknown): Ozlem Guervit, Institute for Neuroradiology, Frankfurt; 3T time-of-flight angiography, resampled isotropically and distributed by VolVis.org. https://github.com/sci-visus/open-scivis-datasets/blob/main/static/open-scivis-datasets/mrt_angio/mrt_angio.json

Distribution-system publication, not proof of simulation authorship (1994): Avila et al., VolVis: A Diversified System for Volume Research and Development. https://doi.org/10.1109/VISUAL.1994.346340 ; author record https://vcg.seas.harvard.edu/publications/19941021-volvis-a-diversified-system-for-volume-research-and-development

DIADEM Challenge data, owner Vincenzo De Paola, MRC Clinical Sciences Centre, Imperial College London; mouse layer-1 axons, in-vivo two-photon imaging. Acquisition date unknown. https://diadem.janelia.org/neocortical_layer_1_axons_readme.html

Related experimental methods (2006), not a known scan date: De Paola et al., Cell type-specific structural plasticity of axonal branches and boutons in the adult neocortex, Neuron 49, 861-875. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.neuron.2006.02.017 ; author record https://repository.cshl.edu/id/eprint/22780/

Origin attribution (simulation date unknown): DFG SFB 382; oxygen-16 two-nucleon probability simulation, distributed by VolVis.org. https://github.com/sci-visus/open-scivis-datasets/blob/main/static/open-scivis-datasets/nucleon/nucleon.json

NIH Clinical Center abdominal contrast CT, first scan of the NIH Pancreas-CT collection according to the curator; scan date unknown. TCIA dataset citation: Roth et al. (2016), https://doi.org/10.7937/K9/TCIA.2016.tNB1kqBU ; https://www.cancerimagingarchive.net/collection/pancreas-ct/ ; selection evidence https://github.com/sci-visus/open-scivis-datasets/blob/main/static/open-scivis-datasets/pancreas/pancreas.json

Related publication (2015): Roth et al., DeepOrgan: Multi-level Deep Convolutional Networks for Automated Pancreas Segmentation, MICCAI, 556-564. https://doi.org/10.1007/978-3-319-24553-9_68 ; https://arxiv.org/abs/1506.06448

CT scanned by Matthew Colbert at UT Austin UTCT on 2014-02-04, 1088 slices at 0.2275 mm; Pawpawsaurus campbelli holotype, supplied by Louis Jacobs, processing by Jessie Maisano. https://www.digimorph.org/specimens/Pawpawsaurus_campbelli/

Origin attribution (scan date unknown): University of Utah CVRTI and SCI Institute; ex-vivo porcine-heart CT, coronary radiopaque contrast and ventricular alginate. Support: Nora Eccles Treadwell Foundation, NIH/NIGMS P41 GM103545-17. https://github.com/sci-visus/open-scivis-datasets/blob/main/static/open-scivis-datasets/pig_heart/pig_heart.json

Independent use of matching 2048x2048x2612 int16 cardiac volume (not an acquisition citation): Wang et al., Interactive Rendering of Large-Scale Volumes on Multi-Core CPUs (2019), Bricktree study. https://www.sci.utah.edu/~feng/assets/papers/bricktree-LDAV.pdf

Dataset released in 2006 by Christoph Heinzl: industrial CT of a Christmas present. Exact acquisition date unknown. Primary dataset record: https://www.cg.tuwien.ac.at/research/publications/2006/dataset-present/

Origin attribution (scan date unknown): Walter Reed Army Medical Center; prone abdominal CT, distributed by VolVis.org. https://github.com/sci-visus/open-scivis-datasets/blob/main/static/open-scivis-datasets/prone/prone.json

Simulation attribution (run date unknown): Cohen, Dannevik, Dimits, Eliason, Mirin, Zhou, Porter and Woodward; entropy field, timestep 160. https://github.com/sci-visus/open-scivis-datasets/blob/main/static/open-scivis-datasets/richtmyer_meshkov/richtmyer_meshkov.json

Related publication (2002): Cohen et al., Three-dimensional simulation of a Richtmyer-Meshkov instability with a two-scale initial perturbation, Physics of Fluids 14, 3692-3709. https://doi.org/10.1063/1.1504452 ; author manuscript https://www.lcse.umn.edu/projects/01/paper_feb5.pdf

Known distribution: VolVis.org; original simulation author and date could not be established. No acquisition authorship inferred from later papers using the volume. https://github.com/sci-visus/open-scivis-datasets/blob/main/static/open-scivis-datasets/shockwave/shockwave.json

Archive attribution (simulation date and original operator unknown): SUNY Stony Brook VolVis distribution, silicon-lattice simulation. https://github.com/sci-visus/open-scivis-datasets/blob/main/static/open-scivis-datasets/silicium/silicium.json

Origin attribution (scan date unknown): Siemens Medical Solutions, Forchheim; rotational C-arm skull-phantom scan distributed by VolVis.org. https://github.com/sci-visus/open-scivis-datasets/blob/main/static/open-scivis-datasets/skull/skull.json
CT scanned by Matthew Colbert at UT Austin UTCT on 2005-02-17, 750 coronal slices; Spathorhynchus fossorium holotype from Wyoming. https://www.digimorph.org/specimens/Spathorhynchus_fossorium/

Dataset released in 2005: specimen from Georg Glaeser, industrial CT by Johannes Kastner and Eduard Groeller; Austria. Exact scan date unknown. Primary dataset record: https://www.cg.tuwien.ac.at/research/publications/2005/dataset-stagbeetle/

Origin attribution (scan date unknown): German Federal Institute for Materials Research and Testing (BAM), Berlin; bronze-statue CT distributed by VolVis.org. https://github.com/sci-visus/open-scivis-datasets/blob/main/static/open-scivis-datasets/statue_leg/statue_leg.json

CAD source https://data-science.llnl.gov/open-data-initiative ; volume attribution https://github.com/sci-visus/open-scivis-datasets/blob/main/static/open-scivis-datasets/synthetic_truss_with_five_defects/synthetic_truss_with_five_defects.json

Simulation date unknown. https://github.com/sci-visus/open-scivis-datasets/blob/main/static/open-scivis-datasets/tacc_turbulence/tacc_turbulence.json

Origin attribution (scan date unknown): Michael Meissner, Viatronix; head angiography, despite the historical name vertebra; supplied through VolVis.org. https://github.com/sci-visus/open-scivis-datasets/blob/main/static/open-scivis-datasets/vertebra/vertebra.json
